name: Café NordSüd
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Café NordSüd in Tirol** – where the charm of the Alps meets the warmth of a cozy café. Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, this inviting spot offers a perfect blend of traditional Austrian hospitality and a relaxed atmosphere. Start your day with a steaming **Melange** or a rich **Einspänner**, or indulge in a hearty breakfast featuring fresh pastries, homemade jams, and our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**. For lunch, savor classic dishes like **Tiroler Gröstl** or a crisp **Käsespätzle**, paired with a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner**. In the afternoon, unwind with a **Eis** (try our seasonal flavors!) or a freshly brewed **Kaffee** while browsing through local books or enjoying the view of the surrounding mountains. Whether you're a traveler exploring **Innsbruck**, a hiker returning from the **Karwendel**, or a local seeking a quiet retreat, Café NordSüd is your go-to destination for good food, great coffee, and genuine **Tiroler Gemütlichkeit**. **Visit us at:**
Café NordSüd
Hauptstraße 42
6020 **Innsbruck**, **Tirol**
Öffnungszeiten: Mo–Sa 8:00–18:00, So 9:00–17:00
